name: Round keep
_about: A ROUND TOWER OF THE GOTHIC REVIVAL CASTLE -- Burg Hohenzollern's Markgrafenturm and Kaiserturm (Stüler, 1850-67): a polygonal (`sides`) shaft R to its corners and H tall in `storeys` under string courses, a round-headed window in a sandstone surround in every 4th face (`windows` dense: every 2nd) of each storey but the first, a door in face 0 (+z) by `door` yes; at its head a GALLERY STOREY Hg tall carried gOut out on a three-stepped corbel table corH deep, a small round-arched window (gW) in every face; a cornice; and by `crown`: "cone" -- a tall slate cone capRise high from capR at the eave, a vane's rod `finial`; "battlement" -- crenellations pH high round the cornice and a drum dR, dH tall set back behind them under a cone dRise; "platform" -- the crenellations alone round the flat deck (a flagpole by `flag` yes), for a stage to stand on or a lookout. (Smaller and corbelled: components/cone-turret; square: castle-tower.)
